description: 首都直下 津波公開データ 06初期水位データ 第08系 [tsunami and flood] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 内閣府　首都直下地震モデル検討会. 断層によるコサイスミックな地殻変動量（上下方向）のデータ 問い合わせの際には、問い合わせフォームの「ご意見、ご感想」記入欄の冒頭に【震度分布・浸水域等に係るデータに関する問い合わせ】とご記入ください。 データのダウンロードは、ユーザ登録の後、 ログイン状態で行ってください。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 内閣府　首都直下地震モデル検討会. Its tags are 地震, 水位, 津波, 首都圏. It offers 6 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
